scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.check:generated-api: sh -c 'generated="lib/api-client-react/src/generated lib/api-zod/src/generated"; if ! git diff --quiet HEAD -- $generated || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- $generated)" ]; then echo "Generated API contract files are out of date. Run pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen and commit the result." >&2; git status --short --untracked-files=all -- $generated; exit 1; fi'
scripts.check:api-contracts: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run codegen && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-client-react run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-zod run typecheck && pnpm run check:generated-api
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run check:api-contracts && pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
